subject: Scheduling: dedicated capacity sizing call (post-discovery)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 28 Feb 2027 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Scheduling: dedicated capacity sizing call (post-discovery)

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today — really helpful to understand FintechCo's use case and traffic profile. Quick recap of what we heard:

- Primary workload: real-time transaction enrichment and summarization for fraud alerts
- Current QPS: ~60 sustained; expected peak bursts to ~250 QPS during business hours
- Typical request size: ~150 tokens in, ~100 tokens out
- Latency target: 200–300ms p95 for production API calls
- Data residency: US-only; SOC2/PCI considerations noted

Next step: schedule a dedicated capacity sizing call (technical deep dive) so our SE team can map throughput/latency to instance counts and recommend a Dedicated plan. From our side I'd like to include David Kim (Solutions Engineer) and Camila Reyes (Sales Engineer) to cover model performance and infra details.

Proposed 45–60 minute slots next week (all times PT):
- Tue Mar 2, 10:00–11:00
- Tue Mar 2, 14:00–15:00
- Wed Mar 3, 09:00–10:00

If none of those work, send a couple times that do or share a Calendly link and we'll accommodate. I'm attaching our capacity-sizing template to collect a few more perf numbers ahead of the call — if you can fill the highlighted sections (peak QPS distribution, request/response token histograms, current model / quantization) that'll speed things up.

Attachments: capacity-sizing-template.xlsx (stub)

Thanks — looking forward to narrowing this down.


Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0199

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Scheduling: dedicated capacity sizing call (post-discovery)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap — that matches what we discussed. We can do Tuesday Mar 2; the 14:00–15:00 PT slot looks good for our team. Priya Rao (eng lead) will join from FintechCo to speak to current infra. A couple of clarifications before the sizing call so David can prep:

- Bursts: the 250 QPS peak is ~5–10 minute bursts during batch settlement windows every 30 minutes (not sustained)
- Concurrency: we expect up to ~40 concurrent in-flight requests during peak bursts
- Model: currently running a 13B open model with int8 quantization; investigating a 30B candidate for accuracy — we'd like performance comparisons if possible
- Persistence: we do not need persistent KV cache across requests for now; mostly cold starts per user session

I'll attach our simple traffic histogram later today (Priya is putting it together). Confirming the 14:00 PT slot — please send a Zoom link and invite.


Alex Johnson
Head of ML Products | FintechCo
alex.johnson@fintechco.com | +1 (212) 555-0147

Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210
Calendar: Invite sent (placeholder) — please accept so the meeting shows on both sides.

Next steps after call: we'll produce a formal capacity plan with expected instance counts, cost estimate, and an optional canary rollout plan for validation.

Thanks all — looking forward to it.
